We are Nyati Motion Pictures

Nyati (Buffalo) Motion Pictures (NMP) is a leading film and video production powerhouse in Uganda, East Africa, established in 2005.

NMP has produced several notable films: Fate (2006), Fair Play(2010), and Windows of Hope (2011) in the feature film category, and A Book for Every Child (2013) in the documentary category, and Tuko Pamoja(2024) a docuseries in the documentary category. Tuko Pamoja is a 13-part historical series exploring Uganda’s precolonial heroes and heroines and centering what the contemporary Ugandan (African) can learn from history.
